summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq (DTSQ/DTSQU/DTSQR), filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026 reporting that sponsor DT Cloud Star Management Limited deposited $75,000 into the trust account to extend the deadline for completing an initial business combination by one month, to October 26, 2026. No target, deal price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine SPAC extension mechanics update; watch trust redemption levels, any announced combination, and further monthly extensions or liquidation risk as the deadline nears.
